v34_adversarial_falsifiers.requirement: 89 capability labels say APPROVED_REQUIRED, but no authentic owner approval -> authority admission rejected
267 test mappings use an outdated source SHA -> affected proof invalidated
Node script named database-rls-test exits zero without contacting PostgreSQL -> no database integration proof
A proof JSON is manually changed to VERIFIED -> certifier rejects absent authentic receipt
No independent reviewer receipt -> independent acceptance remains pending
ApprovedRequiredAtomsComplete omitted -> not implicitly true
Private table absent -> DB existence/RLS gate fails
Anon can execute privileged RPC -> DB security fails
User A can see B Watch -> security fails
User A cannot access own valid Saved -> positive access test fails
Token signed using repository-known secret -> activation rejected
Caller fabricates P3 prerequisites -> activation rejected
Old snapshot exists, latest scan failed -> no VERIFIED_EMPTY
Two physical flights share route/date -> distinct exact IDs
Unknown mandatory fee in apparent cheapest offer -> cannot claim cheapest payable total
Cheapest appears beyond page 1,500 -> server-global ranking remains correct
Saved opportunity lies outside page 120 -> exact-ID current resolution works
Watch creation fails remotely -> only local draft, not ACTIVE
Remote Watch read fails across account switch -> no data leakage or false success
Watch exists but no adequate scan coverage -> PENDING_COVERAGE/DEGRADED
Two workers claim one condition -> one logical episode notification
Email provider accepts request without delivery receipt -> no DELIVERED status
Route-level historical samples feed Buy/Wait -> no calibrated offer-specific probability
MAD=0 and current price differs materially -> abstention/qualified anomaly handling
Economic utility unavailable -> INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, not REJECTED_UNECONOMIC
Provider lacks background collection entitlement -> scanner mode disabled
Preview runs latest SHA, production runs old SHA -> production acceptance denied
All 267 historical gates pass, but approved P2/P3 atom remains incomplete -> TARGET_PROVEN denied
Test oracle changed to agree with broken implementation -> protected oracle gate fails
Mock-browser test claims full-stack acceptance -> proof ceiling rejected
Fake organic users/events satisfy apparent KPI -> real-outcome gate rejects sample
Runtime-soak JSON contains fictional elapsed time -> soak not proven

v35_production_smoke_gates.requirement: Frontend release SHA != Edge release SHA fails strict atomic parity unless authorized compatible tuple is proven
Frontend SHA matches manually edited release.json but deployment revision differs -> FAIL
Edge DEPLOYED_COMMIT is overwritten to match frontend without actual deployment -> FAIL
GitHub PR Verify green, production smoke on main red -> PRODUCTION_NOT_VERIFIED
feed-snapshot returns healthy_empty, 0 deals, 0 routes -> API ok but live-inventory usefulness cannot be certified
flight-search returns 503 -> Degraded source status, no healthy provider claim or false no-flight result
production-truth returns ok=true with totalRows=0 and ALLOW_INDICATIVE_STANDBY=true -> INDICATIVE_STANDBY only
MIN_OBSERVED_FARES=0 -> Does not satisfy nonzero production inventory without authorized decision
Route has no snapshots but scanner never monitored it -> UNMONITORED, not VERIFIED_EMPTY
Snapshot exists for route, not requested date window -> exact query scope remains unmonitored
Edge health is fresh but data source rights missing -> source excluded from authorized production claims
A scheduled GitHub workflow tests main while latest application implementation exists on another branch -> separate branch status
Production smoke job is green but Watch scheduler has no actual coverage -> Watch reliability gate fails
Public frontend is accessible but no qualified opportunity or honest degraded explanation exists -> product journey incomplete
Anonymous security smoke returns HTTP 200 [] -> narrow anonymous boundary only, not full RLS proven
Legacy live deals table has zero rows while observed-fare snapshots contain scoped historical data -> no conflation
A newer production smoke run exists but investigator cites only October 8 historical failure as current -> evidence freshness fails
A workflow is made green by removing release, provider, coverage or negative checks -> semantic integrity FAIL
